democracy.t: Has backed Trump's claims that he won the 2020 election, which Wikipedia describes as false; in 2026 alleged fraud in the Los Angeles mayoral election and called for federalizing elections.
Contested his 280-vote 2022 AG loss in five separate court actions over two years; every court ruled against him on the merits or timeliness (see election_contest_2022).
Stood by his call for an investigation of Runbeck Election Services and Maricopa County over the 2024 election.
